name: Soy sauce and fermented seasoning sauces

Cd.binding_scope: Fish-based condiments (for example fish sauce) (GB 2762-2025 Table 2, item 10.2)

tAs.binding_scope: liquid foods in general except categories with particular limits
tAs.basis: source unit mg/kg or ppm as noted; product/migration basis preserved in notes

iAs.label: Inorganic arsenic is a component of total arsenic (iAs <= tAs). The iAs value (100 ug/kg) is not below the binding total arsenic ceiling (100 ug/kg), so inorganic arsenic is governed by and bounded by the total arsenic ceiling; no separate iAs ceiling is published. The total arsenic is measured on every lot; on ongoing lots iAs is speciated whenever tAs exceeds its limit.

tHg.basis: food as listed; source unit mg/kg or mg/l

MeHg.label: Methylmercury is a component of total mercury (MeHg <= tHg). No in-force sovereign sets a separate MeHg maximum level for this product on its basis, so methylmercury is governed by and bounded by the total mercury ceiling (50 ug/kg); no separate MeHg ceiling is published. The total mercury is measured on every lot; on ongoing lots MeHg is speciated whenever tHg exceeds its reflex trigger.

Ni.label: Ni 15000 ug/kg: disclosed read-across from EU eu2024_ni_soy_beans_15000 (soy beans, oilseed row). Filled by the completeness sweep; nearest applicable sovereign for this matrix and basis.

Cr.source_scope: Beans (dried pulses and flours milled from dried pulses, per Annex A) (GB 2762-2025 Table 7, item 3.1); total Cr, not Cr-VI
Cr.label: Cr 1000 ug/kg: disclosed read-across from CN china_gb2762_crtotal_beans_legumes_1000 (beans and bean products (legumes, pulses)). Filled by the completeness sweep; nearest applicable sovereign for this matrix and basis.

Cr-VI.label: Hexavalent chromium is a component of total chromium (Cr-VI <= Cr). No in-force sovereign sets a separate Cr-VI maximum level for this product on its basis, so hexavalent chromium is governed by and bounded by the total chromium ceiling (1000 ug/kg); no separate Cr-VI ceiling is published. The total chromium is measured on every lot; on ongoing lots Cr-VI is speciated whenever Cr exceeds its reflex trigger.

Sn.label: Sn 250000 ug/kg: disclosed read-across from SG sg_foodregs_2026_any_food_sn_250000 (any food). Filled by the completeness sweep; nearest applicable sovereign for this matrix and basis.

Al.source_scope: baked foods (bread, pastries, cakes, biscuits, cookies, crackers); deep-fried flour products; batter, breading, and frying powder
Al.basis: product as placed on market; dry sample, calculated as Al
Al.label: Al 100000 ug/kg: disclosed read-across from CN cn_gb2760_2024_al_baked_foods_100000 (baked foods (bread, pastries, cakes, biscuits, c). Filled by the completeness sweep; nearest applicable sovereign for this matrix and basis.

method: HMTc Method v2.0 (government-limit default; face value, no reconstitution; read-across / control / not-material for unregulated cells; no occurrence percentiles)
lineage_note: Soy sauce is a fermented seasoning SAUCE, so the Vietnam QCVN 8-2 generic 'Sauce' MLs govern directly (Pb 2000, Cd 1000, tAs 1000, tHg 50) — corroborated by the Singapore 'tomato ketchup and other sauces' finished-sauce ML (Pb 2000 / tAs 1000). These are loose ceilings flagged for the occurrence ratchet; soy sauce has a documented lead-contamination history (e.g. Hong Kong recalls). Nickel is held under a soy-accumulation screen because soybeans concentrate nickel (EU regulates soybean nickel at 15000) and no sovereign sets a sauce nickel ML.
